SELECT c.id, c.product_id, c.user_id, c.contact_name, c.contact_phone, c.contact_email, c.consultation_content, c.reply_content, c.status, c.reply_time, c.reply_admin_id, c.created_time, c.updated_time FROM consultation c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE 1=1
AND p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
AND c.contact_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{contactName}, '%')
AND c.status = #{status}
ORDER BY c.created_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.product_id, c.user_id, c.contact_name, c.contact_phone, c.contact_email, c.consultation_content, c.reply_content, c.status, c.reply_time, c.reply_admin_id, c.created_time, c.updated_time FROM consultation c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_time DESC
